answer_1.quote: We propose the task of knowledge enhanced counseling reflection generation

answer_2.quote: We evaluate our model with several common metrics. We measure the word-overlapping based relevance using BLEU-1/2 , ROUGE-1/2 , and METEOR . We measure the contextual embedding similarity using BertScore . We measure the diversity with the ratio of unique unigrams or bigrams among generated sentences .

answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation where we ask annotators to indicate their preferences... We evaluated each each model response using three metrics: Fluency indicating whether the sentence is grammatically correct and natural; Coherence indicating whether the response is on topic and relevant to the dialogue history; Reflectiveness indicating if the response summarizes what the client has said or interprets what the client means.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators scored responses on Fluency, Coherence, and Reflectiveness using a three-point Likert scale, indicated if retrieved knowledge was helpful, and picked the best response.
